web.title: View your study loan account online - Australian Taxation Office
web.description:
# View your study loan account online
## Going online
- the [20% loan debt reduction](https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/study-and-training-support-loans/view-your-study-loan-account-online#loandebtreduction)

## 20% debt reduction
We have completed processing of the 20% reduction for all [student and training support debts](https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/study-and-training-support-loans/types-of-loans) that existed on 1 June 2025.

- If you’re currently studying:
  - you’ll see additional 20% reduction transactions on your loan account covering loans that are added before 1 July 2024, from 1 July to 31 December 2024, and from 1 January to 31 May 2025 – see [Example 1](https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/study-and-training-support-loans/view-your-study-loan-account-online#Example1Currentlystudyingwithnewl)
  - and started studying from 1 July 2024, you won’t see an indexation transaction because loans less than 11 months old are not indexed.

Study loans that were in credit after the 20% reduction, may have received a [refund of loan credit](https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/study-and-training-support-loans/view-your-study-loan-account-online#refundofloancredit).

# HELP indexation and debt reduction
The legislation made Higher Education Loan Program (HELP) and student loan repayments fairer, and reduced student loan debt by 20%.

## 20% reduction of student loan debt
The Australian Taxation Office (ATO) has completed processing the reductions.

web.title: 20% reduction of HELP debts - Study Assist, Australian Government
web.description:
The Australian Taxation Office (ATO) has started processing the Government’s 20% reduction to HELP debts.

If you had an outstanding HELP debt balance as at 1 June 2025, the ATO will apply the 20% reduction to your debt.

The ATO will notify you when it has applied the 20% reduction to your loan account.

The 20% reduction will also increase your available HELP balance under the HELP loan limit, like a repayment.
